bugClass.title: Dynamic tools cause context churn and repeated input charging
bugClass.cause: A worker starts with only some tools restricted while account or user MCP tools continue loading or changing during the session, causing context growth and tool-list churn. Separately, admission logic fingerprints the entire tools block as one unit, so adding one tool makes every existing tool appear new and recharge as input.
bugClass.criteria: Classify a site when either mechanism is present: (1) a worker launch restricts built-in tools but leaves account/user MCP servers enabled for mid-session loading or updates; or (2) a pre-request context or cost gate hashes or fingerprints the complete tools block as a single field and treats a change to that block as new input for all tools. Either mechanism alone qualifies.

candidates.evidence: Lines 19–24 pass `tools` to `toolParts(tools, prior, count)`, which may fingerprint tool entries individually. The implementation of `toolParts` is not shown, so the excerpt does not establish whether the entire tools block is fingerprinted as one field or causes all tools to recharge when it changes.

Lines 95–99 replace the value following Claude’s `--tools` flag with `Read,Glob,Grep` for read-only tasks. This indicates built-in tool restriction at launch, but the excerpt does not show whether account or user MCP servers remain enabled or can change during the session.

Line 32 adds `--tools Read,Glob,Grep` for read-only turns, restricting the CLI tool set on that path. The excerpt does not show whether account/user MCP servers remain enabled or load/change mid-session, and shows no tools-block fingerprint or input recharge logic.

`src/workflows/reports-media/analyticsRecord.ts:63` hashes serialized `FingerprintValue`, but the excerpt does not show a tools block, pre-request admission/cost gate, or any MCP-loading worker path, so the class trigger is not established.
